title: inspect_unique_values: return top unique values and their counts for a column
description: Return the most frequent unique values and their counts for a categorical or low-cardinality column. Useful when a filter returns empty results and the actual values in a column are unknown.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Name of the column to inspect.

parameters.name: max_values
parameters.description: Maximum number of unique values to return (default 20, max 200).

rag_note: Use when the user asks 'what values does column X contain?', when a filter produced zero rows (possible value mismatch), or when observation signals suspected_wrong_value.
